title: Checkpoint: The Tyrant Check
prompt:
**Task.** n numbers. Print 1 if some value appears STRICTLY more than
n/2 times, else 0.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n ≤ 200000; 0 ≤ a_i < 10^9.

**Adversarial note:** ties and boundary counts (exactly n/2) are where
plausible solutions die. The full-scale test is tie-heavy on purpose.

tests.name: clear majority
no majority
exact half
tests.hint: 2 appears exactly n/2 = 2 times, NOT strictly more → 0. (The >= stumble reports 1.)

tests.name: tie storm
tests.hint: Two values tie at 2 ≤ 2.5 → 0. (The 'mode must be majority' heuristic reports 1.)

tests.name: full scale
tests.hint: n = 200000 tie-heavy by design. Ground truth computed in Python.
